question: Article 76 of the Constitution of India deals with the office of the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Attorney General of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Attorney General of India is appointed by the President of the country, as per Article 76.
 
• The person must be qualified for the post of a Supreme Court Judge to get eligible for this post.
